specs.Qualité: Proof La qualité "Belle Épreuve" est la plus haute qualité numismatique devant les qualités "Brillant Universel" (BU) et "courante". Une pièce belle épreuve est une pièce obtenue au moyen de coins et de flans spécialement préparés et de conditions de frappe particulières, de sorte que les motifs de gravure ressortent avec une grande netteté et que la surface est sans défaut. Les fonds de la gravure sont extrêmement brillants, les reliefs sont matés.

description_detailed: Since 1935, DC, part of Warner Bros. Discovery, has been creating iconic characters and enduring stories, and is one of the world's leading publishers of comics and graphic novels. DC's creative work entertains audiences of all generations around the world with DC stories and characters.In 2025, to celebrate 90 years of DC COMICS, Monnaie de Paris is honoring the iconic characters of the DC COMICS Universe. From Batman, the Dark Knight, to Superman, the Man of Steel, including Wonder Woman, the Amazon Warrior, are all represented on the coins.This exceptional collection of gold and silver coins is inspired by the comics and features the superheroes of DC COMICS. Each coin captures the essence and super-power of these iconic characters thanks to detailed engraving and intense colors, and will transport you into this legendary universe.It all began with Superman, who appeared in 1938. With his superhuman strength, iconic red cape and unshakeable sense of hope and honor, he became a timeless symbol. Shortly afterwards, in 1939, Batman entered the scene. Darker and more mysterious, this masked vigilante from Gotham City, devoid of superpowers but armed with uncommon intelligence, offers a contrasting vision of the hero. In 1941, Wonder Woman established herself as a powerful, revolutionary female figure. An Amazon warrior, she embodies the balance between strengh and courage, becoming an icon for generations. Over the decades, these characters have evolved: the realistic, detailed representations of modern comics have replaced the simple, colourful lines of the early days, and each period has enriched their graphic universe. Today, DC Comics continues to captivate millions of fans around the world, perpetuating this exceptional heritage.The faces of this collector coin feature the Justice League, the ultimate team of the world's greatest superheroes. With their joined forces, they tackle threats too great to fight alone.Although the League calls on reserve members when needed, the core team is made up of three individuals :- Superman: The world's most powerful hero.- Batman: The pinnacle of human physical and mental achievement.- Wonder Woman: The Amazon princess and the League's greatest warrior.The reverse of this collection features a comic-book-style representation of the Justice League with the words "90 years old". The reverse also features the face value of the coin and the initials of the French Republic.
